Research

My work sits at the intersection of ecology, statistics, and computation — developing methods that handle the complexity and uncertainty inherent in natural systems.

View publications →
Bayesian Ecological Modeling

Hierarchical generative models for phenology and species distributions. Stan · PyMC

ML for Ecological Inference

Neural networks + kernel methods paired with mechanistic models. Python · PyTorch

High-Performance Simulation

DOE supercomputing for large-scale ecological simulations. Julia · MPI

Uncertainty Quantification

ABC and sensitivity analysis for complex ODE / PDE systems.
